title: Moonlit Waterfall Cliff
description: A powerful waterfall cascades down a rocky cliff face into a river below, surrounded by lush green hills and dense evergreen forests. The dramatic sky features a glowing full moon, vibrant orange and purple sunset clouds, and mist rising from the base of the falls.
prompt: A majestic waterfall flowing over a rocky plateau cliff into a misty river below, lush green hills covered in pine trees on both sides, dramatic sunset sky with vibrant orange and purple clouds, a bright full moon glowing in the upper left, cinematic lighting with reflections on the water, atmospheric mist, rich detailed oil painting style
